entry.title: Updated: treg
entry.summary: Tool catalog for agents: search ~2,600 external endpoints (SEO and SERP, backlinks, social, people and company enrichment, ad libraries, scraping) by the task you want done, read each one's parameters and per-call price, then call it with the credential injected server-side. Ships the skill plus an MCP row that stays disabled until TREG_TOKEN is set. Exact install spec: github:superdesigndev/treg. Source event: dsh-market/dsh-market; changed: sources.
